blocks.en: Distinguish the MVI, SAVI and AVI inspection methods and where each applies

blocks.en: Become familiar with the key terms defined in TR85, including particle classification, morphological parameters and measurement techniques

blocks.en: 1.0 Introduction

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Visual Inspection, VI (目視檢查): 注射劑成品製程中不可或缺的品質管控手段。不只是「挑出壞品」，更是持續改善製程的資訊來源。
blocks.en: Visual Inspection (VI): An indispensable quality control step in finished injectable manufacturing. It is not only about "picking out bad units"; it is also a source of information for continual process improvement.

blocks.zh: 三種檢查方式：
blocks.en: Three inspection approaches:

blocks.zh: MVI (人工目視檢查): 以裸眼在受控光源和時間條件下檢查，是各國藥典的參考方法
blocks.en: MVI (manual visual inspection): Inspection with the unaided eye under controlled lighting and time conditions; the reference method in pharmacopeias worldwide

blocks.zh: SAVI (半自動目視檢查): 自動化處理容器 + 人眼判斷 + 接受/拒絕決策
blocks.en: SAVI (semi-automated visual inspection): Automated container handling + human eye judgment + accept/reject decision

blocks.zh: AVI (自動目視檢查): 使用數位相機擷取影像，以計算工具分析是否符合預設標準，可被驗證
blocks.en: AVI (automated visual inspection): Uses digital cameras to capture images and computational tools to analyze whether they meet predefined criteria; can be validated

blocks.zh: Probability of Detection, PoD (偵測機率): 特定粒子在特定檢查方法與條件下被看見並移除的可能性。100 µm 粒子的 PoD 僅約 40-50%，而 200 µm 粒子可達 >95%。
blocks.en: Probability of Detection (PoD): The likelihood that a specific particle will be seen and removed under a given inspection method and conditions. The PoD for a 100 µm particle is only about 40-50%, whereas for a 200 µm particle it can reach >95%.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像你在餐廳出餐前檢查每道菜是否有異物。MVI 就像主廚用肉眼一盤盤看；SAVI 就像有輸送帶自動送菜到主廚面前，但仍靠人眼判斷；AVI 則像裝了高解析度攝影機和 AI 辨識系統，自動偵測異常。
blocks.en: Imagine checking every dish for foreign matter before it leaves the restaurant kitchen. MVI is like the head chef looking at each plate with the naked eye; SAVI is like a conveyor belt that automatically brings each dish in front of the chef, who still judges by eye; AVI is like installing high-resolution cameras and an AI recognition system that detects abnormalities automatically.

blocks.zh: 重點在於：即使主廚眼力再好，100 µm 的微小異物（比一根頭髮還細）也只有一半機率被發現。這就是為什麼我們不能只依賴最終檢查，而必須從源頭管控原料和元件的清潔度。
blocks.en: The key point: no matter how sharp the chef's eyesight, a 100 µm foreign particle (finer than a human hair) has only about a 50% chance of being spotted. This is why we cannot rely on final inspection alone, and must control the cleanliness of raw materials and components at the source.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: RTS/RTU 元件為何特別重要？
blocks.en: Why are RTS/RTU components especially important?

blocks.zh: Ready-to-Sterilize (RTS，即用型滅菌) 和 Ready-to-Use (RTU，即用型) 元件在使用前不會再經過額外的清洗或微粒去除步驟。這意味著供應商交付時的微粒水準就是最終水準。
blocks.en: Ready-to-Sterilize (RTS) and Ready-to-Use (RTU) components do not go through any additional washing or particle removal step before use. This means the particulate level at the time of supplier delivery is the final level.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，這代表：
blocks.en: For a CDMO, this means:

blocks.zh: 進料檢驗規格必須比成品規格更嚴格
blocks.en: Incoming inspection specifications must be tighter than finished product specifications

blocks.zh: 與元件供應商的品質協議 (Quality Agreement) 中必須明確納入微粒管控要求
blocks.en: The Quality Agreement with the component supplier must explicitly include particulate control requirements

blocks.zh: 累積效應 (cumulative effect)：容器 + 膠塞 + 充填設備 + 環境，每個來源的微粒都會加總
blocks.en: Cumulative effect: container + stopper + filling equipment + environment; the particles from every source add up

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula
blocks.en: Formula

blocks.zh:
偵測機率的實務意涵：

100 µm 粒子 → PoD ≈ 40-50%
  → 每 100 個含此粒子的單位，約有 50-60 個「漏網之魚」

200 µm 粒子 → PoD > 95%
  → 每 100 個含此粒子的單位，僅約 5 個可能未被偵測

啟示：光靠最終檢查無法達到零缺陷
      必須從元件和製程源頭控制微粒
blocks.en:
Practical implications of detection probability:

100 µm particle → PoD ≈ 40-50%
  → Of every 100 units containing such a particle, about 50-60 "slip through"

200 µm particle → PoD > 95%
  → Of every 100 units containing such a particle, only about 5 may go undetected

Takeaway: final inspection alone cannot achieve zero defects
      Particles must be controlled at the source, in components and processes

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 情境：你的客戶要求注射劑成品的可見微粒拒絕率 (rejection rate) 不超過 0.1%。如果你使用 RTU 膠塞和 RTU 玻璃瓶，而這兩者各自就可能貢獻微粒，再加上充填設備和環境的微粒來源 -- 每個環節的規格都必須遠嚴於最終成品的 0.1% 目標。這就是「累積效應」的實際商業意義。
blocks.en: CDMO scenario: Your client requires a visible particle rejection rate of no more than 0.1% for the finished injectable. If you use RTU stoppers and RTU glass vials, each of which can contribute particles, and then add particle sources from filling equipment and the environment, the specification at every step must be far tighter than the 0.1% finished-product target. This is the practical, commercial meaning of the "cumulative effect".

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼 MVI 是各國藥典的參考方法，但在實務上不能僅依賴 MVI 來確保品質？
blocks.en: Why is MVI the reference method in pharmacopeias worldwide, yet in practice it cannot be relied on alone to assure quality?

blocks.zh: 如果你是 CDMO 品質主管，面對一批 RTU 膠塞的進料檢驗，你會特別關注哪些微粒指標？為什麼？
blocks.en: If you were the quality head at a CDMO facing incoming inspection of a batch of RTU stoppers, which particulate indicators would you focus on, and why?

blocks.zh: AVI 相較於 MVI 的最大優勢是什麼？它是否完全取代了人工檢查的必要性？
blocks.en: What is the biggest advantage of AVI over MVI? Does it completely remove the need for manual inspection?

blocks.zh: 1.1 Purpose 1.1 目的
blocks.en: 1.1 Purpose

blocks.zh: Primary Packaging Components (初級包材元件): 直接接觸藥品的容器和密封件，包括玻璃瓶 (glass vials)、注射器 (syringes) 和彈性膠塞 (elastomeric closures)。
blocks.en: Primary Packaging Components: Containers and closures in direct contact with the drug product, including glass vials, syringes and elastomeric closures.

blocks.zh: TR85 的定位：本報告聚焦於「元件端」的微粒檢測與檢驗方法 -- 也就是在充填之前，針對包材本身建立可靠的測試方法。這是整個「消除注射劑可見微粒」大型倡議的一環。
blocks.en: Positioning of TR85: This report focuses on particulate detection and inspection methods at the component level; that is, establishing reliable test methods for the packaging components themselves before filling. It is one part of the larger initiative to eliminate visible particles in injectable products.

blocks.zh: 如果把注射劑製造比喻為做一道料理，TR85 關注的不是最終成品的品質檢查（那是上桌前試吃），而是食材進廚房前的品質篩選 -- 確保玻璃碗沒有裂痕碎屑、矽膠蓋沒有脫落碎片。食材本身如果帶進異物，不管廚師手藝再好，成品品質都無法保證。
blocks.en: If injectable manufacturing is compared to cooking, TR85 is concerned not with the quality check of the final dish (the taste test before serving) but with screening ingredients before they enter the kitchen: making sure the glass bowl has no chips or cracks and the silicone lid has no shed fragments. If the ingredients themselves bring in foreign matter, the quality of the finished dish cannot be guaranteed, however skilled the cook.

blocks.zh: TR85 的產業背景：本報告是 PDA 推動的一系列消除可見微粒倡議的具體成果。先前已發表概覽 (reference 3) 及微粒進入製程的詳細分析 (reference 4)。TR85 補足了測試方法的缺口 -- 沒有可靠且標準化的測試方法，就無法設定有意義的規格限度。
blocks.en: Industry background of TR85: This report is a concrete outcome of a series of PDA-led initiatives to eliminate visible particles. An overview (reference 3) and a detailed analysis of how particles enter the process (reference 4) were published earlier. TR85 fills the gap in test methods: without reliable, standardized test methods, meaningful specification limits cannot be set.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 業者而言，這意味著你現在可以對供應商說：「我們依據 PDA TR85 的方法來評估你的元件品質。」這提供了一個產業公認的技術基準。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, this means you can now tell suppliers: "We evaluate your component quality using the methods in PDA TR85." This provides an industry-recognized technical baseline.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR85 特別強調 RTS 和 RTU 元件？傳統非 RTU 元件在微粒管控上有什麼不同？
blocks.en: Why does TR85 place particular emphasis on RTS and RTU components? How do conventional non-RTU components differ in particulate control?

blocks.zh: 「沒有可靠的量測方法就不可能建立可靠的管控限度」-- 這個原則如何影響你與包材供應商的品質協議？
blocks.en: "Reliable control limits cannot be established without reliable measurement methods": how does this principle affect your quality agreements with packaging suppliers?

blocks.zh: 1.2 Scope 1.2 範圍
blocks.en: 1.2 Scope

blocks.zh: Particle / Particulate / Particulate Matter (微粒/粒狀物質): 在本報告中三者等義互換。指的是非預期的外來物質，可能附著在初級包材表面或在密封的藥品劑型內自由移動。
blocks.en: Particle / Particulate / Particulate Matter: The three terms are used interchangeably in this report. They refer to unintended foreign matter that may adhere to the surface of primary packaging or move freely within the sealed drug product dosage form.

blocks.zh: Standard Setting Process (標準制定流程): TR85 的方法是這個流程的第一步。邏輯鏈為：
blocks.en: Standard Setting Process: The methods in TR85 are the first step in this process. The logic chain is:

blocks.zh: Step 1: 建立可靠的測試方法 (本報告的核心)
blocks.en: Step 1: Establish reliable test methods (the core of this report)

blocks.zh: Step 2: 使用這些方法評估製程能力 (process capability)
blocks.en: Step 2: Use these methods to evaluate process capability

blocks.zh: Step 3: 基於製程能力數據建立有意義的管控限度 (control limits)
blocks.en: Step 3: Based on process capability data, establish meaningful control limits

blocks.zh: 這就像要管控工廠的室內空氣品質。你不能說「空氣要乾淨」就算設好標準了。你必須先有可靠的空氣品質檢測儀器（對應 TR85 的測試方法），用它去量測現有狀況（對應製程能力評估），然後才能設定合理的 PM2.5 限值（對應管控限度）。沒有好的量測，一切限值都是空談。
blocks.en: It is like controlling indoor air quality in a factory. Saying "the air must be clean" does not set a standard. You first need a reliable air quality monitor (corresponding to the TR85 test methods), use it to measure current conditions (corresponding to process capability evaluation), and only then can you set a reasonable PM2.5 limit (corresponding to control limits). Without good measurement, every limit is empty talk.

blocks.zh: 這句話是整份報告的核心哲學。在製藥業，我們常常看到規格限度是基於傳統或經驗而非數據。TR85 推動的是以數據驅動的品質管控（data-driven quality control）-- 先有方法，再收數據，最後用數據說話。
blocks.en: This statement is the core philosophy of the whole report. In the pharmaceutical industry, we often see specification limits based on tradition or experience rather than data. What TR85 promotes is data-driven quality control: method first, then data, and finally let the data speak.

blocks.zh: 這也與 ICH Q10 的精神一致：持續的品質改善需要建立在客觀量測的基礎上。
blocks.en: This is also consistent with the spirit of ICH Q10: continual quality improvement must be built on objective measurement.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR85 要特別澄清 particle、particulate、particulate matter 三者在報告中是同義的？這在跨國法規環境下有什麼實務意義？
blocks.en: Why does TR85 take care to clarify that particle, particulate and particulate matter are synonymous in the report? What is the practical significance of this in a multinational regulatory environment?

blocks.zh: 請描述從「無測試方法」到「有意義的管控限度」的三步驟流程，並舉一個你工作中可能應用的例子。
blocks.en: Describe the three-step process from "no test method" to "meaningful control limits", and give an example of where you might apply it in your work.

blocks.zh: 2.0 Glossary and Abbreviations 2.0 術語彙編與縮寫
blocks.en: 2.0 Glossary and Abbreviations

blocks.zh: 微粒來源分類 -- Extrinsic vs Intrinsic：
blocks.en: Classification of particle sources: Extrinsic vs Intrinsic:

blocks.zh: Extrinsic Particle (外來微粒): 來自製程外部，例如環境空氣中的纖維、清洗不完全殘留。這些是「不可控的」(uncontrolled)。
blocks.en: Extrinsic Particle: Originates from outside the process, for example fibers in ambient air or residues from incomplete cleaning. These are "uncontrolled".

blocks.zh: Intrinsic Particle (內在微粒): 來自製程內部的合格接觸材料，例如膠塞碎片、玻璃微粒。「非計劃但非意外」(unplanned but not unexpected)。
blocks.en: Intrinsic Particle: Originates from qualified product-contact materials within the process, for example stopper fragments or glass particles. "Unplanned but not unexpected".

blocks.zh: 這個分類非常重要，因為不同來源的微粒需要不同的管控策略。外來微粒要靠環境和清潔管控；內在微粒要靠元件品質和製程參數管控。
blocks.en: This classification is very important because particles from different sources require different control strategies. Extrinsic particles are controlled through environmental and cleaning controls; intrinsic particles are controlled through component quality and process parameters.

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 -- 微粒形態參數
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Particle Morphological Parameters

blocks.zh: 為什麼需要這麼多形態參數？ 因為微粒不是規則的球體，每種量測方式捕捉到的資訊不同：
blocks.en: Why are so many morphological parameters needed? Because particles are not regular spheres, and each measurement approach captures different information:

blocks.zh: Aspect Ratio (長寬比): 區分纖維和顆粒的關鍵 -- 長寬比 ≥5 為纖維，<5 為顆粒
blocks.en: Aspect Ratio: The key to distinguishing fibers from particles: an aspect ratio ≥5 is a fiber, <5 is a particle

blocks.zh: Feret Min/Max: 以平行切線量測的最小/最大距離，常用於自動影像分析
blocks.en: Feret Min/Max: The minimum/maximum distance measured between parallel tangents; commonly used in automated image analysis

blocks.zh: Shape Factor/Circularity (形狀因子): 0 到 1 之間，1 代表完美圓形。可幫助判斷微粒來源
blocks.en: Shape Factor/Circularity: A value between 0 and 1, where 1 is a perfect circle. Helps in determining the source of a particle

blocks.zh: Area、Perimeter、Length、Rect A: 不同的尺寸量測方式，各有適用場景
blocks.en: Area, Perimeter, Length, Rect A: Different ways of measuring size, each suited to different scenarios

blocks.zh: 把微粒分類想像成偵探辦案。你在犯罪現場發現一個可疑物體：
blocks.en: Think of particle classification as a detective solving a case. You find a suspicious object at the crime scene:

blocks.zh: Extrinsic: 就像窗戶被打破後飛進來的外部碎片 -- 來源在場外
blocks.en: Extrinsic: Like debris that flew in after a window was broken; the source is outside the scene

blocks.zh: Intrinsic: 就像房間內家具自然磨損掉落的碎屑 -- 來源在場內
blocks.en: Intrinsic: Like shavings that fell off the furniture in the room through normal wear; the source is inside the scene

blocks.zh: 而各種形態參數就像偵探的量測工具：有的量長度、有的量面積、有的分析形狀 -- 綜合起來才能判斷「這個異物是什麼、從哪來的」。
blocks.en: The various morphological parameters are the detective's measuring tools: some measure length, some measure area, some analyze shape. Only together can they tell you "what this foreign particle is and where it came from".

blocks.zh: 可見微粒 vs 不可見微粒的界線：
blocks.en: The boundary between visible and subvisible particles:

blocks.zh: Visible particle (可見微粒): 長寬比 <5 且長度 >100 µm
blocks.en: Visible particle: Aspect ratio <5 and length >100 µm

blocks.zh: Visible fiber (可見纖維): 長寬比 ≥5 且長度 >300 µm
blocks.en: Visible fiber: Aspect ratio ≥5 and length >300 µm

blocks.zh: Subvisible particle (不可見微粒): 尺寸 <100 µm
blocks.en: Subvisible particle: Size <100 µm

blocks.zh: 注意這裡有一個灰色地帶：100-300 µm 之間、長寬比 ≥5 的纖維既不是「可見纖維」也不是「不可見微粒」。在實務中，這類邊界情況需要特別注意分類標準的應用。
blocks.en: Note that there is a gray zone here: a fiber with an aspect ratio ≥5 and a length between 100 and 300 µm is neither a "visible fiber" nor a "subvisible particle". In practice, such borderline cases require particular attention in applying the classification criteria.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 -- RTS vs RTU
blocks.en: Key Notes: RTS vs RTU

blocks.zh: 關鍵差異：
blocks.en: Key difference:

blocks.zh: RTS (即用型滅菌): 已清洗，需自行滅菌後使用
blocks.en: RTS (Ready-to-Sterilize): Already washed; must be sterilized by the user before use

blocks.zh: RTU (即用型): 已清洗且已滅菌，可直接轉入無菌區使用
blocks.en: RTU (Ready-to-Use): Already washed and sterilized; can be transferred directly into the aseptic area

blocks.zh: 兩者的共同點是：使用前都不會再清洗。因此供應商交付時的微粒水準就是你最終面對的水準。這是為什麼 TR85 對這兩類元件特別重要。
blocks.en: What the two have in common is that neither is washed again before use. The particulate level at supplier delivery is therefore the level you ultimately face. This is why TR85 is especially important for these two types of components.

blocks.zh: CDMO 情境：你收到一批 RTU 膠塞的微粒檢測報告，報告中使用了 Feret Max 作為尺寸量測依據。但你們內部的 AVI 系統是使用 Length（最長軸）來判定。由於同一個不規則形狀的微粒，Feret Max 和 Length 可能給出不同數值，因此你必須確認量測定義的一致性，否則同一批膠塞可能在供應商端「合格」，在你的系統中「不合格」。
blocks.en: CDMO scenario: You receive a particulate test report for a batch of RTU stoppers, and the report uses Feret Max as the basis for size measurement. But your in-house AVI system uses Length (the longest axis) for its decisions. Because the same irregularly shaped particle can give different values for Feret Max and Length, you must confirm that the measurement definitions are consistent; otherwise the same batch of stoppers could "pass" at the supplier and "fail" in your system.

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼 TR85 花大量篇幅統一術語定義。
blocks.en: This is why TR85 devotes so much space to harmonizing terminology and definitions.

blocks.zh: 一個長 250 µm、寬 40 µm 的微粒，其長寬比為多少？它應被分類為「visible particle」還是「visible fiber」？
blocks.en: A particle 250 µm long and 40 µm wide: what is its aspect ratio? Should it be classified as a "visible particle" or a "visible fiber"?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 Extrinsic Particle 被定義為「uncontrolled」而 Intrinsic Particle 被定義為「unplanned but not unexpected」？這對你的管控策略有什麼不同的啟示？
blocks.en: Why is an Extrinsic Particle defined as "uncontrolled" while an Intrinsic Particle is defined as "unplanned but not unexpected"? What different implications does this have for your control strategy?

blocks.zh: 如果你是品保主管，在與供應商簽訂 RTU 膠塞的品質協議時，你會要求使用哪些形態參數來定義微粒規格？為什麼？
blocks.en: If you were the QA head negotiating a quality agreement for RTU stoppers with a supplier, which morphological parameters would you require to define the particle specification, and why?

blocks.zh: 2.1 Abbreviations 2.1 縮寫
blocks.en: 2.1 Abbreviations

blocks.zh: 縮寫分類整理：
blocks.en: Abbreviations grouped by category:

blocks.zh: 檢查方法類：
blocks.en: Inspection methods:

blocks.zh: VI / MVI / SAVI / AVI -- 從人工到全自動的檢查方法譜系
blocks.en: VI / MVI / SAVI / AVI: the spectrum of inspection methods from manual to fully automated

blocks.zh: LO (光遮蔽法) / MM (薄膜顯微鏡法) -- 不可見微粒的分析技術
blocks.en: LO (light obscuration) / MM (membrane microscopy): analytical techniques for subvisible particles

blocks.zh: 法規與標準類：
blocks.en: Regulations and standards:

blocks.zh: cGMP / FDA / ISO -- 法規與標準組織
blocks.en: cGMP / FDA / ISO: regulations and standards organizations

blocks.zh: USP / EP / JP -- 三大藥典體系
blocks.en: USP / EP / JP: the three major pharmacopeial systems

blocks.zh: 元件與品質類：
blocks.en: Components and quality:

blocks.zh: RTS / RTU -- 元件的供應形式
blocks.en: RTS / RTU: the supply forms of components

blocks.zh: AQL -- 抽樣驗收標準
blocks.en: AQL: acceptance sampling standard (acceptable quality limit)

blocks.zh: PoD / SF -- 量測與統計參數
blocks.en: PoD / SF: measurement and statistical parameters

blocks.zh: DOE -- 實驗設計
blocks.en: DOE: design of experiments

blocks.zh: 這些縮寫就像醫院科別的代碼：ER (急診)、ICU (加護病房)、OR (手術室)。對業內人來說是基本語言，但對初學者需要逐一對照學習。建議你把這頁當作「速查表」使用 -- 後續章節大量使用這些縮寫時，隨時回來查閱。
blocks.en: These abbreviations are like the codes for hospital departments: ER (emergency room), ICU (intensive care unit), OR (operating room). They are basic language for insiders but need to be learned one by one by beginners. Use this page as a "quick reference": whenever later sections use these abbreviations heavily, come back and look them up.

blocks.zh: 三大藥典的重要性：USP (美國)、EP (歐洲)、JP (日本) 分別代表全球三大主要藥品市場的品質標準。CDMO 如果服務全球客戶，必須同時了解三套藥典對微粒的要求差異。TR85 的方法旨在提供一個統一的產業基準，但最終規格仍需符合目標市場的藥典要求。
blocks.en: Importance of the three pharmacopeias: USP (United States), EP (Europe) and JP (Japan) represent the quality standards of the three major pharmaceutical markets worldwide. A CDMO serving global clients must understand the differences among the three pharmacopeias' particulate requirements. The TR85 methods aim to provide a unified industry baseline, but final specifications must still meet the pharmacopeial requirements of the target market.

blocks.zh: AQL (允收品質限度): 這是統計抽樣驗收的核心概念，將在後續章節中大量使用。AQL 決定了你需要抽多少樣本、允許多少不良品。
blocks.en: AQL (Acceptable Quality Limit): A core concept of statistical acceptance sampling that will be used heavily in later sections. The AQL determines how many samples you need to draw and how many defective units are allowed.

blocks.zh: LO 和 MM 分別適用於量測什麼範圍的微粒？這兩種技術有什麼互補性？
blocks.en: What range of particle sizes do LO and MM each cover? How do the two techniques complement each other?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 CDMO 需要同時熟悉 USP、EP 和 JP 三套藥典的微粒規定？如果客戶的目標市場是全球，你的規格應該如何設定？
blocks.en: Why does a CDMO need to be familiar with the particulate requirements of USP, EP and JP at the same time? If the clients' target market is global, how should your specification be set?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 目視檢查 (VI) 的三種模式：MVI (人工)、SAVI (半自動)、AVI (全自動) -- 皆為藥典認可方法，但各有偵測極限
blocks.en: Three modes of visual inspection (VI): MVI (manual), SAVI (semi-automated), AVI (fully automated); all are pharmacopeia-recognized methods, but each has detection limits

blocks.zh: 偵測機率 (PoD) 的現實：100 µm 微粒僅有 40-50% PoD，這代表最終檢查無法作為唯一的品質保證手段
blocks.en: The reality of probability of detection (PoD): A 100 µm particle has only a 40-50% PoD, which means final inspection cannot be the sole means of quality assurance

blocks.zh: 源頭管控是關鍵：必須從元件端（玻璃瓶、膠塞）建立嚴格的微粒規格，尤其針對不再清洗的 RTS/RTU 元件
blocks.en: Source control is key: Strict particulate specifications must be established at the component level (glass vials, stoppers), especially for RTS/RTU components that are not washed again

blocks.zh: TR85 的定位：提供標準化的測試方法，作為建立製程能力評估和管控限度的基礎 -- 沒有可靠量測就沒有可靠管控
blocks.en: Positioning of TR85: Provides standardized test methods as the basis for process capability evaluation and control limits; without reliable measurement there is no reliable control

blocks.zh: 微粒分類：Extrinsic (外來) vs Intrinsic (內在) 需要不同管控策略；可見微粒 (>100 µm) vs 不可見微粒 (<100 µm) 需要不同檢測技術
blocks.en: Particle classification: Extrinsic vs Intrinsic particles require different control strategies; visible particles (>100 µm) vs subvisible particles (<100 µm) require different detection techniques

blocks.zh: 形態參數統一：Aspect Ratio、Feret、Shape Factor 等定義的一致性是跨組織溝通和品質協議的基礎
blocks.en: Harmonized morphological parameters: Consistent definitions of Aspect Ratio, Feret, Shape Factor and so on are the basis for cross-organization communication and quality agreements
